subject.title: Tustin Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 3

text: Governing Board Member, Tustin Unified School District Trustee Area 3
Education: Harvard MBA, BA Mathematics Claremont McKenna College

As a school board member, I have successfully advocated for fundamentals – quality phonics-based reading instruction, rigorous standards in math and science, practical support for classroom teachers and hands-on Career Technical Education that prepares students both for college and well-paying careers.

A past corporate CFO, fiscal responsibility matters. As Board President, I’ve led bond refinancings saving local taxpayers over $48 million - dollars you won't be paying! We earned an upgraded rating from Moody’s.
The independent website Niche.com ranks TUSD in the Top 4.2% of over 10,000 districts nationwide. We’ve had 17 California Distinguished School awards in the past five years.

The independent Education Scorecard report from Stanford placed TUSD in the Top 20% nationwide in overall student achievement, Top 10% in Academic Growth, found students learning math faster than 90% of other districts and low-income students among the fastest improving academically. Over 70% of our graduates are prepared for four-year colleges, giving them control over their futures.

In challenging times our schools need proven leaders with vision and results. Thank you for your support over the years! Re-elect Lynn Davis to protect taxpayers, maintain safe schools and support increasing excellence in our school district.

text: As a parent, educator, and scientist, I am running for the Tustin Unified School District Board of Education to ensure every student receives an outstanding education in a safe, supportive, and academically focused environment.

My husband and I raised our two sons in public schools, and I understand firsthand the importance of strong schools and engaged families. I hold a doctorate in education and two master's degrees in science, and have spent more than 20 years teaching science at the college and high school levels.
From cancer research labs to biotechnology classrooms, I know the value of critical thinking, evidence-based decision-making, and preparing students for success in college, careers, and life.

As a Board member, I will keep students at the center of every decision, promote academic excellence, ensure fiscal responsibility and transparency, and strengthen partnerships with parents. I will support career technical education, arts, music, and athletics, plan for declining enrollment and aging schools, and protect taxpayer resources.
I will bring practical leadership, put students first, and preserve the district our community is proud of. I would be honored to serve.
